verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a claim that every SDK shares the same identity model, so a user instrumented once is understood everywhere across web, mobile, server and game engines. That loosely implies cross-device identification but gives no specifics. Missing for 10: documented user ID / device ID identify calls, explicit cross-device identity resolution, merging anonymous pre-signup events into the identified profile, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
